companies.name: Harbor Ledger
companies.about: Harbor Ledger builds cloud accounting and payroll tools used by 40,000 small and mid-sized businesses. Our product, data and support teams work across New York and Toronto, with a remote-friendly engineering group.

companies.name: Kestrel Robotics
companies.tagline: Warehouse robots that work alongside people
companies.about: Kestrel designs autonomous picking robots for mid-size warehouses. We ship hardware, firmware and a fleet dashboard, and our customers include grocery and pharmacy distributors across North America.

companies.name: Lumen Health
companies.tagline: Primary care that fits around your day
companies.about: Lumen Health runs 32 primary care clinics and a virtual care service across Ontario. Our clinicians, care coordinators and product teams work together to cut wait times and keep patients with the same doctor.

companies.name: Fernway Foods
companies.about: Fernway is a regional grocery chain with 86 stores and a growing online delivery business. We buy directly from more than 400 British farms and run our own distribution centres.

companies.name: Quillstone Publishing
companies.about: Quillstone publishes around 60 new titles a year in print, ebook and audio, and produces three weekly podcasts. We are small, editorial-led and proud of our backlist.

companies.name: Tidewater Energy
companies.about: Tidewater develops and operates community solar farms and grid batteries in New South Wales and Victoria. We have 410 MW in operation and a pipeline of regional projects.

companies.name: Brightpath Logistics
companies.about: Brightpath moves palletised freight for retailers and manufacturers across 14 European countries, with our own routing platform and a network of partner carriers.

companies.name: Cobalt & Pine Studio
companies.tagline: Brand and product design for ambitious teams
companies.about: Cobalt & Pine is a design studio working on brand identity, websites and product design for startups and non-profits. Small teams, long relationships, no pitch decks without research.

companies.name: Verdant Labs
companies.tagline: Open source tools for climate data
companies.about: Verdant Labs builds open source pipelines and APIs that make satellite and sensor climate data usable for researchers, insurers and city planners. We are fully remote across 11 time zones.

companies.name: Orchard Lane Schools
companies.tagline: Independent K-12 schools with small classes
companies.about: Orchard Lane runs four independent schools in the Greater Toronto Area, with 2,100 students and a teaching team known for project-based learning.

companies.name: Pinecrest Hotels
companies.about: Pinecrest operates 23 boutique hotels in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam. We hire locally, train for the long term and promote from within.

companies.name: Bluefin Payments
companies.about: Bluefin helps online merchants in Asia-Pacific get paid in 30 currencies and settle to local bank accounts the next day.

companies.name: Ironbark Construction
companies.tagline: Commercial and civic buildings, built to last
companies.about: Ironbark delivers schools, hospitals and mixed-use developments across Australia, with a strong focus on safety and low-carbon timber construction.

companies.name: Meridian Care Partners
companies.about: Meridian provides home health, hospice and senior living services in Texas and Oklahoma, supported by 2,800 nurses, aides and therapists.

companies.name: Signal North
companies.about: Signal North makes a shared inbox and live chat product used by 9,000 support teams. We care about quiet, fast software and a calm way of working.

companies.name: Atlas Ridge Engineering
companies.about: Atlas Ridge advises on bridges, transit and water infrastructure for public clients in France, Belgium and Switzerland.

companies.name: Wildflower Coffee Co.
companies.about: Wildflower roasts direct-trade coffee and runs nine cafes in Austin and San Antonio, plus a subscription service shipping nationwide.

companies.name: Northgate Mutual
companies.about: Northgate Mutual is a member-owned insurer covering 1.2 million homes and cars in the north-east United States.

companies.name: Paperkite
companies.tagline: Scheduling software for clinics and studios
companies.about: Paperkite is a small product company building booking and reminders software for physiotherapy clinics, yoga studios and salons.

companies.name: Solstice Media
companies.about: Solstice produces documentary series for streaming platforms and runs a commercial video studio in Brooklyn.

companies.name: Greenline Transit Authority
companies.tagline: Public transit for the Bay Area
companies.about: Greenline runs bus and light rail services carrying 180,000 riders a day across three Bay Area counties.

companies.name: Harvest Commons
companies.about: Harvest Commons coordinates 38 food banks and community kitchens across London, supported by 1,600 volunteers.

companies.name: Copperleaf Analytics
companies.about: Copperleaf helps retailers set prices and promotions with forecasting models trained on their own sales data.

companies.name: Marlow & Finch LLP
companies.about: Marlow & Finch advises growing companies on employment, property and commercial contracts from offices in London and Manchester.
